request.prompt:

Code:
```python
def iscube(a):
    a = abs(a)
    return int(round(a ** (1. / 3))) == a
```

Test output:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "solution.py", line 31, in <module>
    check(iscube)
    ~~~~~^^^^^^^^
  File "solution.py", line 22, in check
    assert iscube(64) == True, "Fourth test error: " + str(iscube(64))
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
AssertionError: Fourth test error: False
```

In at most three sentences, state the root cause of the bug. Do not write code.
